about: What bb tool graphics runs: ImageMagick for resizing, cropping and comparing images, resvg for SVG to PNG, and oxipng, pngquant and cwebp for shrinking what an app ships.
label: Graphics tools (ImageMagick, resvg, oxipng, pngquant, cwebp)
name: graphics

run: g="$(ldd --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/.* //')"; case "$g" in [0-9]*.[0-9]*) ;; *) g="";; esac; if [ -n "$g" ] && [ "$(printf '%s\n' 2.35 "$g" | sort -V | head -1)" != "2.35" ]; then echo "ImageMagick's AppImage needs glibc 2.35 and this node has $g (Rocky 9 and the other 2.34 systems): the graphics tools cannot run here" >&2; exit 1; fi; dst="$2"; bin="$dst/bin"; t="$(mktemp -d)"; mkdir -p "$bin"; get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$2" "$1"; }; tag() { curl -fsSIL -o /dev/null -w '%{url_effective}' "https://github.com/$1/releases/latest" | sed 's#.*/tag/##'; }; v="$(tag ImageMagick/ImageMagick)"; im="$t/magick.AppImage"; get "https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/releases/download/$v/ImageMagick-$v-gcc-x86_64.AppImage" "$im"; chmod +x "$im"; (cd "$t" && "$im" --appimage-extract >/dev/null); rm -rf "$dst/magick"; mv "$t/squashfs-root" "$dst/magick"; ln -sf ../magick/AppRun "$bin/magick"; rs="$1"; if ! tar -tzf "$rs" >/dev/null 2>&1; then rs="$t/resvg.tgz"; get https://github.com/linebender/resvg/releases/latest/download/resvg-linux-x86_64.tar.gz "$rs"; fi; tar -xzf "$rs" -C "$t"; cp "$(find "$t" -name resvg -type f | head -1)" "$bin/"; v="$(tag oxipng/oxipng)"; get "https://github.com/oxipng/oxipng/releases/download/$v/oxipng-${v#v}-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz" "$t/ox.tgz"; tar -xzf "$t/ox.tgz" -C "$t"; cp "$(find "$t" -name oxipng -type f | head -1)" "$bin/"; get https://pngquant.org/pngquant-linux.tar.bz2 "$t/pq.tbz"; python3 -c 'import sys, tarfile; tarfile.open(sys.argv[1]).extractall(sys.argv[2])' "$t/pq.tbz" "$t"; cp "$(find "$t" -name pngquant -type f | head -1)" "$bin/"; wv="$(curl -fsS 'https://api.github.com/repos/webmproject/libwebp/tags?per_page=20' | grep -o '"name": *"v[0-9.]*"' | sed 's/.*"v//; s/"//' | sort -V | tail -1)"; get "https://storage.googleapis.com/downloads.webmproject.org/releases/webp/libwebp-$wv-linux-x86-64.tar.gz" "$t/webp.tgz"; tar -xzf "$t/webp.tgz" -C "$t"; cp "$(find "$t" -path '*/bin/cwebp' -type f | head -1)" "$(find "$t" -path '*/bin/dwebp' -type f | head -1)" "$bin/"; chmod +x "$bin"/*; rm -rf "$t"
